observations: Three photos show orange LPG gas cylinders, one specifically offered for sale (closest, orange, with brass valve and plastic carry handle)
Background shows a red cylinder in mesh netting, a blue cylinder, and a gas burner/stove top, suggesting a shop or storage area with multiple units
Photo 2 shows a clear brand marking 'REPSOL' and partial Spanish-language safety text, plus a printed capacity marking that reads 'Butano 12,5' (kg)
Visible wear: scuffed orange paint, scratches, small rust specks near the base, and a visible dent/crease near the top handle area in photo 0
No regulator, hose, or burner included in the listing photos for the item itself
No visible manufacture/test date stamp, no weighing scale shot, and no shot confirming the cylinder is pressurized or empty
Valve looks intact with a brass fitting, but no close-up of threads or seal condition is given

claims.evidence: photo 2 shows Repsol branding and Spanish-language text, consistent with a foreign-manufactured cylinder
photo 2 shows a printed capacity marking reading 'Butano 12,5'
no way to test structural integrity, valve seal, or pressure rating from photos alone

risks.risk: Cylinder may be past its safety recertification/expiry date (LPG cylinders require periodic testing)
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the stamped manufacture/test date on the cylinder collar or shoulder
risks.if_unproven: priced as due for recertification / not verified safe

risks.risk: Valve or threads may be worn, leaking, or damaged
risks.proof: Close-up photo or short video of the valve being opened/closed, plus soap-bubble leak test
risks.if_unproven: priced as valve condition unknown, assume needs inspection

risks.risk: Internal corrosion or rust not visible from outside
risks.proof: Photo of interior via empty cylinder inspection or a recent hydrostatic test certificate
risks.if_unproven: priced as condition unknown, worst case

risks.risk: Cylinder may be sold empty despite 'gas cylinder' listing implying contents
risks.proof: Photo of a weighing scale showing gross weight, or a fill receipt
risks.if_unproven: priced as empty, no gas included

risks.risk: Visible dent near the top could indicate impact damage affecting safety
risks.proof: Multiple angle close-ups of the dented area and any associated paint cracking
risks.if_unproven: priced as cosmetic-to-structural damage unresolved, worst case

proof_requests: Clear close-up of the manufacture/test date stamp on the cylinder collar
Video of the valve opening/closing and a leak test with soapy water
Photo of the cylinder on a scale showing tare and gross weight
Multiple angles of the dented area near the top handle
response.reason: The item is clearly identifiable as a 12.5kg Repsol-branded foreign-used LPG cylinder with visible wear and no proof of recent safety testing or valve integrity, so it can be priced at worst case pending further proof.
